description.fun: Shellos looks different depending on which side of Sinnoh's Mount Coronet it lives: pink in the West Sea, blue-green in the East Sea. Squeeze its squishy body and a sticky purple fluid oozes out, thought to be a kind of stress sweat, and it's a pain to wash off. Its ancestors had shells, hence the name, and Game Freak first meant it for Ruby and Sapphire.
description.guide: Shellos is a Water-type sea slug found in two forms, West Sea (pink) and East Sea (blue), named for the sides of Sinnoh's mountain range where they live. It oozes a sticky purple fluid when threatened. It evolves into Gastrodon.
description.tagline: A sea slug that changes colour with the coast it calls home.

description.fun: Gastrodon is squishy but tough: if a fish Pokémon bites a piece off, it grows back within a few hours. Like Shellos it comes in West and East Sea colours, and the two are known to clash. Its head tentacles look like cattle horns, perhaps a pun on umiushi, Japanese for sea slug, which means 'sea cow', and it starred in artwork for the 2021 Year of the Ox.
description.guide: Gastrodon is the evolved form of Shellos, a Water- and Ground-type sea slug with West Sea and East Sea forms. It lives in tidal pools and on shorelines, can regrow lost body parts within hours, and once had a shell on its back.
description.tagline: A regenerating sea slug in two rival colours.
